decisions.statement: Every push deep-links to the feed page.
The feed page is the only page a notification has.
No kind of push routes anywhere else.
The deep-link route rides outside `aps` at the payload's top level.
The person a notification belongs to is always among the ones pushed at.
A surplus fall also reaches the shared app.
A push to the shared app has no deep link.
Nobody is pushed at twice where the shared app is owned by the same person.
Every app a push reaches is named on `push-apps` rather than here.

definition: what one push carries, and whose devices it is carried to
